label: UNIT3D
description: Standard UNIT3D private tracker. Provides /api/user stats and scrapes the /users/{username} profile page for extended stats.
notes: capabilities.api_stats is the STOCK UNIT3D /api/user response. Forks vary: one returning more should say so with api_stats_add in its own def (see zenith), one returning less with api_stats_omit. join_date is listed here because the forks that omit it already declare api.required_fields: ["join_date"], which is subtracted automatically. NEEDS CONFIRMATION against a live stock instance — assembled from the test fixture and field map rather than from UNIT3D's own documentation.
